findings.desc: scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-identity-cutover.mjs:754-763 concept-cleanup: HIGH — the claimed exact residue boundary is bypassed by prefix-wide exclusions for all docs/requirements/decisions, all fixtures, and .proof-or-stop/dev-memory. This contradicts proof-or-stop-identity-cutover.md:106-147, which forbids directory exemptions and says docs/requirements is not generally frozen. The bypass is observable in current normative truth sources: docs/requirements/decisions/story-lifecycle.md:7,68,101,303,335,343 still teaches lattice-review-story-init / lattice-review-test-coverage / lattice-review-*; docs/requirements/decisions/testing-infra.md:9,141,151,160 does the same, yet the verifier prints PASS identity-cutover. WHY: the user-required Agent rename is incomplete on active lifecycle documentation and the GREEN residue claim is vacuous over broadly skipped roots; replace active role names and make exemptions exact/fail-closed instead of directory-wide.

packages/main/src/tasks/scope-contract-smoke.ts:186-225 and :386-413 cover only a rename-old positive plus one unrelated ambiguous-missing negative for the new exactRepoRootPaths path. They do not mechanically exercise the delete-positive branch or M/A/C/rename-target/untracked/glob negatives described by packages/main/src/core/scope-contract.ts:259-297 and packages/main/src/core/scope-path-classifier.ts:146-150. WHY: the current implementation is narrow, but a later parser broadening could silently turn the acknowledgement provenance into an escape hatch without this smoke failing; defer a complete status-matrix cohort to a follow-up story.

scripts/verify-global-lab-entrypoint.mjs:7-37 and :60-115 invoke the repository-local bin and local Lab dist; they never npm pack/install the four tarballs or disable registry/network fallback. packages/main/src/tasks/proof-or-stop-only-absence-smoke.ts:28-66 only checks generated bootstrap text and config loading; it never enumerates installed bins, invokes lattice, resolves @lattice/core|lab|utils, or resolves the 13 retired roles. Yet CHK-003:edge:0/adversarial:0, CHK-004:happy:0/adversarial:0, CHK-005:adversarial:0, and CHK-007:happy:0/edge:0 are mapped to those commands, and evidence_inspect reports transcriptRefs=[] with no pack/install command. WHY: this is a false-green product-boundary gap; a packed manifest/bin/dependency/role regression can pass all recorded receipts even though the cutover decision requires network-disabled clean-install positives and negatives.

package-install-boundary: packages/lab/package.json:15 and packages/utils/package.json:15 pin @proof-or-stop/core@0.3.65 while packages/main/package.json:8 packs the only supplied core tarball as 0.3.268. Therefore the mandated four-tarball clean install cannot close its dependency graph with registry/network fallback disabled; it must fetch a second core@0.3.65 that these artifacts do not provide. scripts/verify-global-lab-entrypoint.mjs:12,72-73 incorrectly codifies the mismatch as expected, and CHK-003/CHK-007 evidence invokes that workspace-only verifier rather than the promised tarball install. Align the extension dependency constraints with the packed core version (and locks/verifier), then record a mechanically executed empty-project install of only the four tarballs under disabled fallback.

migration-atomicity: packages/main/src/handlers/identity-state-migrate.ts:108-132 publishes destinationRoot and recursively deletes sourceRoot before creating the required receipt with flag wx. If the receipt already exists or lines 124-132 fail, the catch at lines 134-136 cannot roll back because tempRoot has already been renamed: the command reports failure with the source gone, destination live, and receipt missing/stale. This violates the cutover decision atomic-move-plus-receipt contract and can strand an unverifiable one-shot migration. Preflight the receipt path and make destination publication/source removal/receipt commit recoverable as one bounded transaction, with an adversarial test for receipt collision/write failure.
